title: email_complete request
description: POST /api/v1/email/complete (SPEC 9). Creates the tester. Idempotent: a repeat returns a token for the same tester (unique email_hash; optional idempotency_key per ADR-09). pending is the 30-minute token from email/verify, in the BACKEND ADR-20 format p<keyver>.<email_hash>.<invite_id>.<age_band>.<iat>.<mac>; the server checks its MAC and age before anything else.
